title: Containerized Application Delivery Platform (Capstone)
objective: Design, build, test, secure, publish, deploy, and document a complete multi-service application that another developer can reproduce.
skills: Configuration, networking, or storage as relevant

milestones.title: Plan and architecture
acceptance_criteria: Describe the workload, inputs, service boundaries, and expected result.
Map the project to relevant lesson IDs and official references.

milestones.title: Build the smallest working version
acceptance_criteria: Run the project in an isolated environment using synthetic data.

milestones.title: Verify behavior and failure handling
acceptance_criteria: Capture normal behavior and at least one edge/failure case.
Inspect logs, configuration, persistence and access controls relevant to the project.

milestones.title: Document reproducibility and recovery
acceptance_criteria: Provide exact startup, verification, reset and rollback steps.
Document platform/version assumptions and explain the principal trade-offs.

key_features: Separate Dockerfiles where appropriate; efficient multi-stage builds and controlled context
Suitable networks and persistent storage; externalized configuration and secret handling
Health checks, logs, resource limits, non-root runtime, reviewed privileges
Automated build/test/security review and authorized publishing; versioned release identity and SBOM where supported
Backup/restore demonstration, deployment and recovery documentation, and rollback procedure
required_features: Separate Dockerfiles where appropriate; efficient multi-stage builds and controlled context
Suitable networks and persistent storage; externalized configuration and secret handling
Health checks, logs, resource limits, non-root runtime, reviewed privileges
Automated build/test/security review and authorized publishing; versioned release identity and SBOM where supported
Backup/restore demonstration, deployment and recovery documentation, and rollback procedure
stretch_features: Add automated configuration validation where the selected tools support it.
Add a reproducible test plus a rollback/recovery rehearsal.
tests_and_acceptance: A clean setup follows the written steps.
Expected behavior is observed and recorded.
At least one failure/edge case is checked.
No credentials or production data are included.
review_method: Human review of repository artifacts, local test evidence, security assumptions, and documentation. CodeLeaf does not run arbitrary Docker or host-administration commands in the web process.
status_note: Draft project brief mapped to Section D of Docker.pdf; requires a working local test and human review before publication.
